findings.rule: WhileSubscribed rule (repo standard; sibling tailor ViewModels use WhileSubscribed(5_000))
findings.trigger: stateIn(..., SharingStarted.Eagerly, ...) keeps the combine of the application and credits flows collecting for the ViewModel's lifetime even when the screen is off-screen or backgrounded; same at QuickQuestionViewModel.kt:44.
findings.title: UI state uses SharingStarted.Eagerly instead of WhileSubscribed
findings.proof: Lint or review check: grep SharingStarted.Eagerly in feature/analysis/impl/src/main/**/result and **/question.

findings.rule: D40/D47 labels never break inside a word; use whole-word text
findings.trigger: Requirement text, title and subtitle use plain Text; a long single word (e.g. a long tool or place name) at font scale 2.0 on 337dp breaks mid-word, and the shared WholeWordAutoSize/TmrWholeWordText is not used anywhere in the PR.
findings.title: Must-have rows, title and subtitle do not use the whole-word text primitive
findings.proof: Screenshot test with a requirement containing one 18-character word at font 2.0 asserting breaksInsideWord is false.

findings.trigger: assertNoTruncatedText checks overflow, clipping and ellipsis only; fixtures have no long unbreakable word, so a mid-word break passes the suite.
findings.title: Layout test cannot detect a mid-word break

findings.trigger: Double tap on Continue or Skip this launches two save+Tailor events; forwardToTailoring runs twice, popping the first Tailoring key and navigating again with a new run id (D56). Same double tap on Tailor my resume in JobResultViewModel.onTailor pushes two QuickQuestion keys.
findings.title: No guard against repeated Continue, Skip or Tailor taps

findings.trigger: Marker glyphs ✓ and ~ are hard-coded literals outside strings_result.xml, and the circle has no content description, so a screen reader gets no status for MET, PARTIAL or GAP.
findings.title: Must-have marker has no accessible description and literal glyphs

findings.trigger: ScreenForKeywords lists every keyword of a PARTIAL requirement under 'In your resume', although only part of the requirement is evidenced, so an uncited keyword can show as held.
findings.title: PARTIAL requirements put all their keywords in the have chips
